Unit 2 — My visit to a museum

On Saturday 3rd July, I visited the Natural History Museum of Oman in Muscat. It is special because you can learn about the plants, animals, deserts and mountains of Oman. You could see animals, birds, fish and there was also a whale! I learnt a lot about our amazing country.
